title: 观者自在 (AlreadyThere)：多模型互查的资料整理程序（原型第一期） / AlreadyThere: a multi-model cross-verification program for fact compilation (prototype phase 1)
description:
多个不同厂商的大模型各自检索、各自作答，另一模型逐条审查；凡程序能核对的一律由程序核对；全过程写入哈希链账本。原型第一期（1.x）。测试结果与前提条件见 README 与“测试记录”。

Several LLMs from different vendors search and answer independently while another model reviews each entry; everything checkable is checked by the program; the whole process is recorded in a hash-chained ledger. Prototype phase 1 (1.x). See the README and test records for results and conditions.

AI collaboration: design ideas formed in the author's conversations with DeepSeek, Doubao, Claude and ChatGPT; code written by Claude (Anthropic); DeepSeek, Kimi and Doubao served as program roles in test runs. Models are not listed as authors.
